senses.definition_en: child (offspring)

examples.english: Parents will be able to educate their children more easily in a non-sexist way.
examples.ref: 1976 November 11, Álvaro García Meseguer, “Sexismo y lenguaje”, in Cambio16, archived from the original on 13 Oct 2007:
examples.text: Les progenitores podrán educar a sus hijes más fácilmente en forma no sexista.
examples.translation: Parents will be able to educate their children more easily in a non-sexist way.

examples.english: […] textbooks are exclusive, they do not reflect the existence of trans people, nor that of other minority realities, our daughters, children and sons are invisible in the educational system”.
examples.ref: 2018 June 13, Guillermo Alonso, “Sin miedo ni reglas: la generación de niños, niñas y niñes trans que cambiará el mundo”, in El País, Madrid, →ISSN:
examples.text: […] los libros de texto son excluyentes, no reflejan la existencia de las personas trans, ni la de otras realidades minoritarias, nuestras hijas, hijes e hijos son invisibles en el sistema educativo”.
examples.translation: […] textbooks are exclusive, they do not reflect the existence of trans people, nor that of other minority realities, our daughters, children and sons are invisible in the educational system”.

examples.english: In 2010, French women did 71 percent of the housework and 65 percent of the work related to their children.
examples.ref: 2020, Aurélia Blanc, Educar contra el machismo, Roca Editorial, →ISBN:
examples.text: En 2010, las francesas se encargaron del 71 por ciento de las tareas del hogar y del 65 por ciento de las labores relacionadas con les hijes.
examples.translation: In 2010, French women did 71 percent of the housework and 65 percent of the work related to their children.
